ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between low-intensity (near-black) base pigmentation and high-intensity (white) linear and circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base color is contiguous low-intensity dark gray to black. High-intensity pixels are distributed in linear filaments across the central regions and dense clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central notch with an approximate 45-degree convergence angle and a significant vertical indentation into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with higher frequency peaks on the right lobe and larger, more erratic notches on the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to an upward and outward taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity circular pixel clusters representing barnacle colonization are concentrated at the far-left and far-right distal tips, with smaller clusters near the lower midline.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear streaks of varying lengths (rake marks) scattered across both lobes, cutting through the dark base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks covering approximately 40% of the visible surface; heavy calcified barnacle clusters at the fluke tips altering the natural edge geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive intersecting linear scars forming a cross-hatch pattern on the right lobe; dense barnacle growth at distal points creates a jagged, white-capped appearance.
